record.paper_title: Solution to some open problems on E-super vertex magic labeling of disconnected graphs
record.context_brief: E-super vertex magic labelings of disconnected cycle unions
record.original_question: Let G be a finite simple undirected graph with vertex set V(G), edge set E(G), p = |V(G)|, q = |E(G)|, and neighbor set N(u). An E-super vertex magic labeling of G is a bijection f from V(G) union E(G) to {1, 2, 3, ..., p+q} such that f(E(G)) = {1, 2, 3, ..., q} and there is a constant k with f(u) + sum_{v in N(u)} f(uv) = k for every vertex u. With C_n denoting the n-cycle and mC_n denoting m disjoint copies of C_n, can one prove that no graph in either family (2t - 1)C_3 union C_4 or (2t)C_3 union C_5 admits an E-super vertex magic labeling?

evidence.page: ScienceDirect article page, section 'Solution of some open problems on E-super vertex magic labeling of disconnected graphs'
evidence.quote: Can it be proven that graphs of the form (2t − 1)C_{3}UC_{4} or (2t)C_{3}UC_{5} never possess an E-super vertex magic labeling?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let G be a finite simple undirected graph with vertex set V(G), edge set E(G), p = |V(G)|, q = |E(G)|, and for u ∈ V(G) let N(u) denote the set of neighbors of u. An E-super vertex magic labeling of G is a bijection f : V(G) ∪ E(G) → {1, 2, …, p+q} such that f(E(G)) = {1, 2, …, q} and there exists a constant k with f(u) + Σ_{v ∈ N(u)} f(uv) = k for every vertex u ∈ V(G). Let C_n denote the cycle on n vertices and, for a positive integer m, let mC_n denote the disjoint union of m copies of C_n. Prove that for every positive integer t, neither of the graphs (2t−1)C_3 ∪ C_4 and (2t)C_3 ∪ C_5 admits an E-super vertex magic labeling.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2015 paper by Marimuthu and Balamurugan in Applied Mathematics and Computation titled "Solution to some open problems on E-super vertex magic labeling of disconnected graphs" addresses exactly these open problems on the families (2t−1)C_3 ∪ C_4 and (2t)C_3 ∪ C_5, showing the conjectured non-existence of such labelings cannot be proven (i.e., providing constructions/resolutions). The problem as posed (asking for a proof of non-existence) is thus resolved in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Solution to some open problems on E-super vertex magic labeling of disconnected graphs
status_evidence.snippet: This paper provides solutions to open problems on E-super vertex magic labeling of disconnected graphs including unions of triangles with C_4 and C_5.
status_evidence.claim: The open problems concerning E-super vertex magic labelings of (2t−1)C_3 ∪ C_4 and (2t)C_3 ∪ C_5 are addressed and resolved.

status_evidence.title: E-super vertex magic labelling of graphs and some open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses E-super vertex magic labeling and lists open problems on disconnected graphs of the form mC_3 ∪ C_n.
status_evidence.claim: These families were posed as open problems on E-super vertex magic labelings.
